'''Wobani Penitentiary''' was a prison on [[Wobani]], where the convicted criminal [[Avrac Kefundee]] was serving a 25-[[Standard year|year]] sentence for aggravated assault of a [[New Republic officer]]. The sentence was listed on his profile, which was among a number of profiles seen by [[Marshal]] [[Carasynthia Dune]] when she searched for that of the criminal [[Migs Mayfeld]]<ref name="Chapter 14" /> around [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|14|the mention of Selnesh}}</ref>
